name: Gridsprung – Grid Blocks for Bootstrap
author: stefoe

sections.description:
Gridsprung brings the Bootstrap 5 grid into the WordPress block editor as real, native blocks. What you build in the editor is saved as plain Bootstrap HTML: no shortcodes, no inline CSS, no extra wrappers.

Gridsprung is an independent project by einseitensprung and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Bootstrap project.

Blocks

  • Gridsprung Container – .container, .container-fluid or .container-{sm…xxl}, optional wide/full alignment.
  • Gridsprung Row – .row with gutters (g-0…5), vertical alignment and horizontal distribution. Ready-made layouts: 6/6, 4/4/4, 3/3/3/3, 8/4, 4/8, centered 8 and centered 6.
  • Gridsprung Column – widths 1…12, auto or equal per breakpoint from xs to xxl, plus offsets (offset-{bp}-*). Live class preview in the sidebar.
  • Gridsprung Divider – <hr> with color, thickness, opacity, spacing and width.

Highlights

  • Saved markup is standard Bootstrap 5. It keeps working even if you deactivate the plugin, as long as your theme loads Bootstrap.
  • Bootstrap grid CSS is bundled and loaded locally: no CDN, no cookies, no external requests.
  • Works with classic and block themes.
  • Translation-ready.

A Pro version with Button, Button group, Accordion, Table, Cards, Alert and Icon blocks is available at einseitensprung.at/gutstrap.

Third-party resources

This plugin bundles the Bootstrap 5.3 grid CSS (assets/bootstrap-grid.min.css).

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via Plugins › Add New (search for “Gridsprung”) or upload the ZIP file.
  2. Activate it.
  3. In the block editor, type “Gridsprung” in the inserter. All blocks are in their own “Gridsprung” category.

Already using the full Bootstrap in your theme? Switch off the bundled grid CSS:

add_filter( 'gridsprung_load_bootstrap_css', '__return_false' );

Divider colors and spacing utilities (border-*, opacity-*, my-*) need the full Bootstrap CSS from your theme.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Bootstrap theme?

No. The grid (Container, Row, Column) works out of the box with the bundled Bootstrap grid CSS. For divider colors and spacing, load the full Bootstrap CSS in your theme.

Does it load anything from external servers?

No. All files are shipped with the plugin. Gridsprung sets no cookies and sends no data.

What happens to my content if I deactivate the plugin?

The saved content is plain Bootstrap HTML. It stays in your posts; with Bootstrap loaded by your theme, the layout keeps working.

What happens when I install the Pro version?

The Pro version contains all Gridsprung blocks. While it is active, Gridsprung switches itself off and shows a notice; you can then deactivate it. All existing blocks stay valid.
